_readme: Names come from the character artwork (owner's direction, 17 Nov 2026). In the app, refer to people by first name, or Mr/Mrs/Miss and surname. All characters, employers and crimes are fictional. Unconfirmed items are cyan.

player.role: A servant on the estate, told in second person
player.task: The housekeeper asks you to find a missing sealed order before the evening collection. No real-time countdown.

fictional_employer: [[c:Not named yet; must not be the real Proby family.]]

cast.secret: Gave grain to a hungry family without permission.

cast.motive: Hid the order to delay an inspection that would expose his private grain sales.

notes: The steward must not be obvious early.
Placeholder names Alice Miller, Thomas Carter, Anne Fletcher and Edward Harwood are retired.
